question: What is the name of the largest waterfall in Kerala?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Athirappilly falls.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **The correct answer is option 4, Athirappilly Falls.**
 
• ** Athirappilly Falls is located in the Thrissur district of Kerala and is one of the largest waterfalls in India.**
 
• ** Dudhsagar Falls** is not in Kerala but in the neighboring state o**f Goa**.
 
 
• It is a four-tiered waterfall on the** Mandovi River** and is popular among tourists.
 
 
 
• ** Vazhachal Falls** is another popular** waterfall in Kerala, but it is not the largest.**
 
 
• **​** It is located on the** Chalakudy River** and is surrounded by dense forests.
 
 
 
• **Kunchikal Falls **is not in Kerala but in the neighboring state o**f Karnataka.**
 
 
• **​ **It is the** highest waterfall in India and is located in the Western Ghats.**
